podcast.title: Diverse Drumming Experience
podcast.body: Danny Carey's drumming career includes playing with a "weirdo band" called Green Jelly, as well as with renowned artist Carole King, showcasing a diverse range of musical experiences before and during his time with Tool. "And drummer Danny Carey was playing with everyone from a weirdo band called Green Jelly to Carol King."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Embraced Modern Electronic Drums
xref.body: Will Champion of Coldplay is among the contemporary drummers who have embraced modern electronic drums. These kits are used to trigger a variety of sounds, tones, patterns, and samples to suit their musical needs. "Today's electronic drums have been embraced by players such as Danny Carey, Neil Peart, Will Champion of Coldplay, Rob Borden of Lincoln Park, and many, many others."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Instrumental in Forming Tool
xref.body: Tom Morello played a crucial role in the formation of the band Tool by introducing his former classmate Adam Jones and Jones's new friend, singer Maynard James Keenan, to drummer Danny Carey. "Meanwhile, Adam Jones, who had also moved west, was looking to form his own band. Tom introduced Adam and his new friend, singer, Maynard James Keenan, to a drummer named Daddy Kerry. So, yeah, Tom basically put two all together."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Young Drum Prodigy
xref.body: Nandi Bushell is an adorable young drum prodigy, not yet a teenager, who displays exceptional drumming talent. She is considered capable of filling in for Danny Carey of Tool due to her skill. Dave Grohl is a "huge, huge fan" of hers, recognizing her remarkable ability at such a young age. "She's not even a teenager yet, but if Toul ever needed someone to fill in for Danny Kerry, this kid could do it. She is that good. Dave Grohl is a huge, huge fan of Nandy Bushel."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
